typographie_suggestion.explanation: The main title "CHIMIE GÉNÉRALE" exhibits the classic characteristics of the Didone style: a high contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and small, unbracketed (hairline) serifs. This style was highly prevalent in academic and formal printing during the early to mid-19th century.
